data.title: SaaSTARTER
data.subtitle: Production-Ready SaaS Template
data.description: A comprehensive Next.js SaaS starter kit with integrated authentication, e-commerce, CMS, and internationalization — designed to eliminate months of boilerplate development.
data.full_description: SaaSTARTER is a production-ready template that combines Next.js 16, PayloadCMS, Better-Auth, and Stripe into a cohesive foundation for launching SaaS products. It provides pre-built authentication flows, a full e-commerce system with cart and checkout, an admin dashboard, multi-language support, and SEO optimization out of the box.
